name: Viking® 5 Series 30" Blush Double Electric Built In Oven
shortDescription: The Viking® 5 Series 30" Blush Double Electric Built-In Oven offers powerful cooking capabilities with even heat distribution and precise temperature control. Featuring multiple cooking modes and a spacious interior, it ensures consistent, reliable results while providing ample space for large meals and multiple dishes.
metaDescription: Viking 5 Series Ovens deliver full throttle commercial cooking power and the most spacious oven cavities in the industry. Transform your kitchen into a chef's playground. Electric ovens and steam ovens offer ultra-premium features and liberating convenience. The Viking Professional 30" Built-In Electric Double Ovens deliver a spacious electric oven with premium features. With the largest oven cavity, patent pending convection system, and improved performance, these self-cleaning ovens raise the benchmark for ultra-premium kitchens.

features.text: Commercial-Type Cooking Power
20% Larger RackView™ trimless windows on the Oven Doors for better visibility into the oven
Exclusive BlackChrome™ Knobs ship standard
Largest oven cavity in the industry makes room for all your cooking needs
Patented Vari-Speed Dual Flow™ convection system has the largest fan in the industry; the 8 1/2" two-speed fan works bi-directionally for maximum airflow and excellent cooking results
Concealed 10-pass dual bake element makes the oven cavity easy to clean while providing precise temperatures
Rapid Ready™ Preheat provides one of the fastest preheat times so your oven is ready to begin cooking when you are
Each oven has six porcelain-coated rack positions and comes standard with three oven racks including one TruGlide™ full extension oven rack (one in the upper oven)
Improved halogen lighting makes it easy to see inside
10-pass broiler with heat reflector directs heat directly into the food for quicker results (upper and lower ovens)

High performance cooking modes include TruConvec™ convection cooking, convection roast, convection bake, convection broil, conventional bake, and three-level conventional broil (convection features in top oven of double ovens only)
Set the oven to begin cooking up to 24 hours later and shut off when cooking time is complete with the Timed Bake feature
Self-clean feature on all ovens
Self-clean oven setting with indicator light
Easy Operation and Cleanup
Large, easy-to-read, commercial-type knobs and bezels
Heavy-duty oven door handle
High-density insulation contains heat within the oven cavity for maximum energy savings and performance, even during high-temperature self-cleaning
Concealed 10-pass dual bake element makes for easy clean up of the oven cavity
Multiple design options
Oven can be installed flush to the cabinet with the accessory Flush Mount Installation Kit
Oven can be installed in a normal application to stand proud from the face of the cabinet
